_doc: Narration for PaperPilot: your PDFs, your device. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption, 'tts' = what Liam reads (Hindi in Devanagari, English words in English, letters spelled out: P D F, O C R, M C P; plural PDFs written पीडीएफ्स so Liam says 'pee-dee-effs', not 'P-D-F-S' (user correction 2026-10-29)); phrase punctuation must match. Each line opens 'scene'; 'min' = minimum scene length (holds the user's 55 s storyboard), 'pre' = designed silence before the line. Every claim from docs/factcheck.md. The user's script word for word, except line 8: 'Indian developer' removed because no source states the creator's location (F12).

reel.cap: RUKO! Apni private PDFs random websites pe upload kar rahe ho? Ye dekho!
reel.tts: रुको! अपनी private पीडीएफ्स random websites पे upload कर रहे हो? ये देखो!

reel.cap: Ye hai PaperPilot! Rust mein bana open-source PDF toolkit, jo browser mein locally kaam karta hai!
reel.tts: ये है Paper Pilot! Rust में बना open-source P D F toolkit, जो browser में locally काम करता है!

reel.cap: PDF merge karo, split karo, compress karo. Scanned documents? OCR se text bhi nikaalo!
reel.tts: P D F merge करो, split करो, compress करो. Scanned documents? O C R से text भी निकालो!

reel.cap: Same Rust engine browser, desktop aur command line mein bhi kaam karta hai!
reel.tts: Same Rust engine browser, desktop और command line में भी काम करता है!

reel.cap: Aur sabse crazy part? Iska native MCP server! Claude Code jaise AI agents bhi iske PDF tools use kar sakte hain!
reel.tts: और सबसे crazy part? इसका native M C P server! Claude Code जैसे AI agents भी इसके P D F tools use कर सकते हैं!

reel.cap: Bas bolo, ye teen PDFs merge karo, aur final file compress kar do!
reel.tts: बस बोलो, ये तीन पीडीएफ्स merge करो, और final file compress कर दो!

reel.cap: Processing local hai, lekin cloud AI ko document data mil sakta hai. Settings check karna!
reel.tts: Processing local है, लेकिन cloud AI को document data मिल सकता है. Settings check करना!

reel.cap: Krushna Vardhan Reddy ka open-source project! Comment PAPER, repo link bhejunga!
reel.tts: क्रुष्णा वर्धन रेड्डी का open-source project! Comment PAPER, repo link भेजूँगा!
